groups.title: Tokyo Jujutsu High — Current Students
groups.def: Present-day (2018) students enrolled at Tokyo Jujutsu High as of the anime through ep 59: first-years Yuji, Megumi and Nobara (still a student though her fate after Shibuya is unresolved); second-years Maki, Toge, Panda and Yuta; third-years Hakari (suspended) and Kirara (away with him). Excludes staff and alumni (Gojo, Ieiri, Ijichi, Kusakabe, Yaga, Nanami, Mei Mei), Grade 2 sorcerer Ino (who works out of the school but isn't a student), Kyoto students, and people seen as students only in the 2006–07 flashback (Geto, Haibara).

groups.title: Curses
groups.def: Non-human curse beings as the anime presents them: the cursed spirits Mahito, Jogo, Hanami, Dagon and Rika; Sukuna, the King of Curses (a Heian-era sorcerer who survives as a curse through his fingers and vessel); and the half-human, half-curse Death Painting brothers Choso, Eso and Kechizu. Excludes every human — sorcerers, curse users (Kenjaku, Uraume, Geto), Toji, incarnated Culling Game players — plus Junpei (a human transfigured by Mahito), the cursed corpse Panda and shikigami. Same nine as the site's 'Cursed Spirit' affiliation tag.

groups.title: Jujutsu High Staff (Tokyo & Kyoto)
groups.def: The principals, teachers, in-house doctor and assistant manager of the two jujutsu schools: Tokyo's principal Yaga, teachers Gojo and Kusakabe, doctor Ieiri and assistant manager Ijichi; Kyoto's principal Gakuganji and teacher Utahime. Not field sorcerers who merely work with the schools (Nanami, Mei Mei).

groups.title: Tokyo Jujutsu High Students in 2006
groups.def: Tokyo Jujutsu High students the anime shows as students in the Hidden Inventory / Premature Death flashback (2006–07): second-years Gojo, Geto and Ieiri and first-years Nanami and Haibara. Excludes Utahime and Mei Mei (shown only as working sorcerers on a mission, ep 25), their teacher Yaga, Riko (a pupil at an ordinary junior high), Toji and Yuki; Ijichi never appears as a student in the anime.

groups.title: Kyoto Jujutsu High Students
groups.def: Students of Kyoto Jujutsu High shown in the anime, alive or dead: the six Goodwill Event competitors (Todo, Mai, Nishimiya, Kamo, Miwa, Mechamaru) plus first-year Arata Nitta, who comes to Shibuya with his upperclassman Todo and treats Nobara and Yuji (ep 44). Excludes teacher Utahime and principal Gakuganji. (Tile is 'Arata Nitta' so he isn't confused with his sister Akari Nitta, a Tokyo assistant manager.)

groups.title: The Zenin Clan
groups.def: Sorcerers born into the Zenin family by blood, including those who left or were estranged from it — Toji, who was disowned, and Megumi, who was raised apart from the clan but is its blood heir and is named its head in Naobito's will (ep 48). Excludes Mahoraga, a shikigami tied to the clan's inherited technique, not a family member.

groups.title: Culling Game Players
groups.def: Everyone the anime (through ep 59) shows as a Culling Game player: Yuji (registered as a player from the start because of Sukuna, who isn't counted separately), Megumi, Yuta, and Hakari and Panda (who declare entry at the Tokyo No. 2 Colony, ep 54); awakened modern players Higuruma and Takaba; and incarnated players Reggie, Uro, Kashimo, Angel and Ishigori. Kirara stays outside the barrier, Maki and Kamo only enter after the anime's cutoff, and Kenjaku runs the game rather than playing it.

groups.title: Civilians Drawn Into the Jujutsu World
groups.def: Characters the anime shows living as civilians — not sorcerers, jujutsu students, curses or members of a sorcerer clan — before the jujutsu world pulls them in: Yuji (a high-schooler who swallows Sukuna's finger, ep 1), Yuta (a schoolboy haunted by Rika before he enrols, JJK0), Junpei (a high-schooler Mahito recruits), Riko (the Star Plasma Vessel, a junior-high pupil), and Higuruma and Takaba (a lawyer and a comedian awakened for the Culling Game). Excludes everyone first shown as a sorcerer, student, curse or clan member (Megumi, Nobara, Toji, Geto, Todo, Nanami) and the incarnated sorcerer Angel.

groups.title: Reincarnated Culling Game Players
groups.def: Culling Game players who are sorcerers from past centuries incarnated into modern bodies: Uro and Angel (Heian era; Tengen introduces Angel as a 1,000-year-old sorcerer in ep 50), Kashimo and Ishigori (400 years ago) and Reggie. Excludes modern-day players (Yuji, Megumi, Yuta, Hakari, Panda, Higuruma, Takaba) and incarnations who aren't players themselves: Sukuna (inside the player Yuji), Uraume and the Death Painting brothers.

groups.title: The Four Special Grade Sorcerers
groups.def: The four sorcerers the anime ranks Special Grade: Gojo, Geto and Yuki Tsukumo ('the three special grades' of 2007, ep 29) plus Yuta (JJK0; rank reclaimed by 2018, ep 58). Excludes Special Grade curses and cursed objects (Sukuna, Rika, the disaster curses, the Death Painting wombs), the Zenin clan's 'Special Grade 1' rank (Naobito, Naoya), and Yuji, whose Special Grade rank comes only from the sequel manga Modulo.

groups.title: Grade 1 Sorcerers
groups.def: Sorcerers the anime ranks Grade 1, counting the Zenin clan's 'Special Grade 1' elites (a Grade 1-equivalent rank; ep 38 calls Nanami and Naobito 'the two grade 1 sorcerers'): Nanami, Mei Mei, Todo, Kusakabe, Yaga, Naobito, Naoya. Excludes Semi-Grade 1 and lower ranks (Toge, Kamo, Mechamaru, Utahime, Megumi, Panda, Nobara, Mai, Maki), people only called 'comparable to' Grade 1 (Higuruma, ep 56; Choso, ep 21), students merely recommended for Grade 1 (Yuji, Megumi, Nobara, Maki, Panda, ep 24), and Special Grades.

groups.title: Inherited Techniques
groups.def: Characters who inherited by blood one of the anime's clan techniques: Ten Shadows (Megumi), Limitless (Gojo), Cursed Speech (Toge), Blood Manipulation (Kamo, and Choso through his Kamo-ancestor blood) and Projection Sorcery (Naobito and his son Naoya). Excludes Eso and Kechizu, whose Rot Technique is their own innate technique; Yuta, who only copies Cursed Speech; and Nobara, whose grandmother link is Fanbook-only.

groups.title: Used a Domain Expansion
groups.def: Characters shown casting Domain Expansion in the anime through ep 59, even if it was cut short: Gojo, Sukuna, Jogo, Mahito, Dagon, Megumi, Higuruma, and Yuta, Uro and Ishigori in their triple clash (ep 59). Hanami's attempt was interrupted before it formed (ep 20), so this group never shares a board with Curses; Hakari, Kenjaku, Yuki and Naoya only use theirs after the cutoff; Simple Domain (Miwa, Kusakabe) and Utahime's Solo Forbidden Area don't count.

groups.title: Reverse Cursed Technique Users
groups.def: Characters shown or stated in the anime (through ep 59) to use Reverse Cursed Technique: Ieiri, Gojo (since his fight with Toji), Sukuna, Yuta and Uraume (healing Choso's shot in Shibuya, ep 46). Hakari, Kenjaku, Yuki, Higuruma, Yuji and Choso only use it after the cutoff, and curses regenerating with cursed energy (Mahito and co.) don't count.

groups.title: Tokyo No. 1 Colony Players
groups.def: Culling Game players the anime shows inside the Tokyo No. 1 Colony (eps 54–58): Yuji, Megumi, Higuruma, Takaba, Reggie and Angel. Sukuna, inside Yuji, isn't a player; Hakari, Panda and Kashimo are in Tokyo No. 2; Yuta, Uro and Ishigori are in Sendai.

groups.title: Fought Mahito
groups.def: Characters shown in a battle against Mahito (or one of his split bodies) in the anime: Yuji, Nanami (Vs. Mahito arc and Shibuya), Mechamaru (eps 30–31), Nobara and Todo (Shibuya), and Gojo, who strikes Mahito on the Shibuya platform (ep 33). Junpei never fought him. Sukuna slashing Mahito inside Yuji's soul (eps 12–13) and Kenjaku absorbing a beaten Mahito are arguable, so this group never shares a board with any group containing Sukuna or Kenjaku.

groups.title: Lived 1,000 Years Ago
groups.def: Characters the anime places in the Heian era, about a thousand years ago: Sukuna and his servant Uraume, Kenjaku (alive ever since by body-swapping), and Culling Game incarnations Uro (a Fujiwara clan assassin) and Angel. Kashimo and Ishigori are from 400 years ago, Reggie's era is never given, and the Death Painting brothers date from the Meiji era.

groups.title: Died in Season 3
groups.def: Characters whose deaths happen or are first announced in Season 3 (The Culling Game Part 1, eps 48–59): Naobito (his death from Shibuya injuries is announced in ep 48), Naoya and Mai (during Maki's massacre of the Zenin clan, ep 51), Yaga (executed, ep 52) and Reggie (beaten by Megumi, ep 58). Yuji's 'execution' is faked by Yuta, and Nobara's fate is left open.

groups.title: Kenjaku's Children
groups.def: Characters Kenjaku is a parent of, as the anime reveals: the Death Painting brothers Choso, Eso and Kechizu (Kenjaku, as the Meiji-era Noritoshi Kamo, mixed his blood into them; ep 46) and Yuji (born of Kaori Itadori's body while Kenjaku possessed it; ep 49). The student Noritoshi Kamo is only a descendant of the clan, not Kenjaku's child.
